root = ET.fromstring(RIGHT_HAND_XML)

# ── Build defaults map ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
defaults = {}
for cls in root.iter("default"):
    cname = cls.get("class")
    if cname is None:
        continue
    jnt = cls.find("joint")
    pos = cls.find("position")
    axis = [0, 0, -1]
    if jnt is not None:
        ax = jnt.get("axis")
        if ax:
            axis = [float(v) for v in ax.split()]
        rng = jnt.get("range")
        if rng:
            lo, hi = [float(v) for v in rng.split()]
            defaults[cname] = {"axis": axis, "ctrlrange": [lo, hi]}
    if pos is not None and cname not in defaults:
        rng = pos.get("ctrlrange")
        if rng:
            lo, hi = [float(v) for v in rng.split()]
            defaults[cname] = {"axis": axis, "ctrlrange": [lo, hi]}

print("Defaults:")
for k, v in defaults.items():
    print(f"  {k}: {v}")

# ── Extract joints ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
joints = []
for jnt in root.iter("joint"):
    name = jnt.get("name")
    if name is None:
        continue
    cls  = jnt.get("class", "")
    jtype = jnt.get("type", "hinge")
    # axis: explicit on element, else from class default
    ax_str = jnt.get("axis")
    if ax_str:
        axis = [float(v) for v in ax_str.split()]
    else:
        axis = defaults.get(cls, {}).get("axis", [0, 0, -1])
    # range
    rng_str = jnt.get("range")
    if rng_str:
        lo, hi = [float(v) for v in rng_str.split()]
        ctrlrange = [lo, hi]
    else:
        ctrlrange = defaults.get(cls, {}).get("ctrlrange", [None, None])
    joints.append({"name": name, "type": jtype, "axis": axis, "ctrlrange": ctrlrange})

print(f"Total joints: {len(joints)}")
for j in joints:
    print(f"  {j}")

# ── Extract actuators ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

for act in root.iter("position"):
    name = act.get("name")

    cls = act.get("class", "")
    # ctrlrange: explicit or from class default
    cr_str = act.get("ctrlrange")
    if cr_str:
        lo, hi = [float(v) for v in cr_str.split()]

    else:

    actuators.append({"name": name, "joint": jnt_name, "ctrlrange": ctrlrange})

print(f"Total actuators: {len(actuators)}")

# ── Sites ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

print(f"\nSites: {sites}")
